TITLE: RetroBoot Rescue
SCOPE: Independent floppy startup; target hard disk 0x80.
LIMIT: Partition metadata only. No repair or OS start.
READY: No hard-disk access yet. Enter starts the diagnosis.
OK: Read completed; supported partition layout is plausible.
BAD_LAYOUT: Read completed; partition layout rejected. Check the codes.
NO_DISK: No hard disk reported by the BIOS.
PARAMS: Unsupported or unreadable BIOS disk parameters.
IO: MBR read failed after bounded retries.
CHANGED: MBR changed during diagnosis; result discarded.
HELP: Enter: inspect  F4: file  F5: compare  F6: plan  F7: dry run  Esc: clear
IDENTITY: Observation only; no verified medium identity or write permission.
B_SCOPE: Saved backup: RBBACKUP.RBB on floppy A:
B_LIMIT: Saved metadata only. No target match, repair or OS start.
B_IO: Floppy read failed after bounded retries.
B_FILE_BAD: Floppy filesystem or file allocation rejected. Check the codes.
B_BAD: Saved backup content rejected. Check the codes.
B_OK: Saved FAT boot areas are consistent.
B_HELP: Enter: check again | F5: compare HDD | F6: plan | Esc: diagnosis
B_BOUNDARY: Saved file only; no verified target identity or restore permission.
T_SCOPE: Compare RBBACKUP.RBB with first hard disk (0x80).
T_LIMIT: Read-only metadata comparison. No restore or OS start.
T_OK: Saved identity and layout match current HDD metadata.
T_CAPACITY: Saved and current disk capacities differ.
T_GEOMETRY: Saved and current BIOS read route or geometry differ.
T_IDENTITY: Saved and current supported media identities do not match.
T_LAYOUT: Saved and current layouts or management-volume bounds differ.
T_CHANGED: Source or target changed during the check; result discarded.
T_BAD: Current HDD metadata is unreadable, unsupported or inconsistent.
T_HELP: Enter/F5: compare | F4: file | F6: plan | Esc: diagnosis
T_BOUNDARY: Metadata match only; no unique physical identity or restore permission.
P_SCOPE: Preliminary backup read plan for the first hard disk (0x80).
P_LIMIT: Full boot-area checks and live payload CRC32. No backup file or writes.
P_OK: Plan and payload checks passed in both read passes; no file created.
P_BAD: Read plan rejected. Check the codes; no ranges retained.
P_TABLE: Range    Kind               First LBA        Sectors        CRC32
P_HELP: Enter/F6: new plan | Left/Right: page | Esc: diagnosis
P_BOUNDARY: No backup file. Original-MBR provenance unresolved; no restore.
S_LIMIT: Each generated sector is compared with RBBACKUP.RBB.
S_BAD: Dry run failed. All provisional results discarded.
A_MENU: R Review current MBR   V Verify saved MBRs   E First enrollment   Esc Exit
A_DATA: Insert mbr-original-data.img in A and press Enter.
A_BACK: Insert mbr-review.img in A and press Enter.
A_SAVE_DATA: Save approval: insert mbr-original-data.img in A and press Enter.
A_SAVE_BACK: Finish approval: insert mbr-review.img in A and press Enter.
A_DECIDE: Y Approve this revision   Esc Reject
D_PROFILE: The boot diskette has no valid target enrollment.
D_ABSENT: No supported ATA hard disk found on the primary IDE master.
D_ACTION: Esc Finish check   E Confirm first install and capture original MBR
D_INSERT: Insert mbr-original-data.img in A and press Enter. Esc cancels.
D_MENU: P Check hard disk   R Review changes   V Verify saved records
D_FIRST: E First capture before installation   Esc Exit
D_BACK: Insert mbr-target.img in A and press Enter.
D_SAVE_BACK: Finish approval: insert mbr-target.img in A and press Enter.
D_BOTH: P Check both disks   R Review changes   V Verify saved records
D_REC_ABSENT: Recovery disk absent or this operation is unsupported.
D_REC_LABEL: Recovery disk label mismatch. Access blocked.
D_REC_FIRST: E Save original MBR on this recovery disk   Esc Exit
D_REC_REVIEW: R Reserve a review number on this recovery disk   Esc Exit
STORE_MENU: S Save to recovery disk   V Verify saved backup   Esc Exit
STORE_SAVE: Saving metadata from the system disk.
STORE_VERIFY: Checking the backup on the recovery disk.
STORE_USED: A backup already occupies this recovery disk.
STORE_MEDIA: Recovery disk missing, unsuitable or different.
STORE_SOURCE: System disk missing, different or unreadable.
STORE_HISTORY: MBR history could not be verified.
STORE_DONE: Backup published on the recovery disk.
STORE_READ: Backup read from the recovery disk.
PAIR_MENU: 1 Capture and approve MBR   2 Save and verify metadata
RESTORE_BACKUP: Backup or independent MBR approval could not be verified.
RESTORE_TARGET: System disk or current partition layout could not be verified.
RESTORE_SCOPE_BAD: Boot code or its disk binding is outside this repair scope.
RESTORE_INTACT: The approved start code is already present.
RESTORE_SCOPE: Restore MBR start code at LBA 0, bytes 0x0000 through 0x01AF.
RESTORE_KEEP: Keep the current loader pointer, disk ID and partition table.
RESTORE_CONFIRM: Y Restore these bytes   Esc Cancel
RESTORE_CHANGED: The disk or backup changed. Repair cancelled.
RESTORE_IO: Write, flush or readback failed. Boot recovery again to check.
RESTORE_DONE: Start code restored. All 512 bytes of the MBR read back and checked.
JR_SCOPE: The intended partition is active. Switch 2 is awaiting completion.
JR_CONFIRM: Y Record the completed switch   Esc Cancel
JR_DONE: Switch completed. Journal and current MBR verified.
JR_INTACT: The partition switch is already complete.
JR_BAD: The journal does not identify a recoverable first switch.
JR_CONFIRM_BOTH: Y Save MBR copy and completion   Esc Cancel
JR_SNAPSHOT_DONE: MBR copy saved to the journal and verified.
JR_PREPARED: Switch 2 is prepared. The partition table still matches its old state.
JR_PARTIAL: Switch 2 is prepared. The partition table has been partly updated.
JR_MBR: System partition table, MBR at LBA 0
JR_APPLY: Y Apply and complete the partition switch   Esc Cancel
JR_INCOMPLETE: Preparation for switch 2 is incomplete. The MBR is unchanged.
JR_PREPARE_APPLY: Y finish preparation and complete the switch   Esc cancel
JR_PREPARE_DONE: Preparation saved to the journal and verified.
JR_UNFINISHED: The new MBR copy is incomplete. The live MBR still has its old contents.
JR_DISCARD: Y restore the journal baseline   Esc cancel
JR_DISCARDED: Journal baseline restored. Partition table verified.
JR_BASELINE: No partition switch is pending. Both journal copies verified.
PR_UNDO: The intended MBR copy is incomplete. Restore the previous journal.
PR_FINISH: The complete intended MBR matches the external approval.
PR_SECTORS: System disk sectors to write, in order (LBA):
PR_CONFIRM: Y Repair the listed sectors   Esc Cancel
PR_IDLE: The last profile switch is complete. No repair is needed.
PR_BAD: No matching later profile switch can be recovered.
PR_UNDONE: Previous journal restored. The original profile remains active.
FP_CHOICES: Sectors per cluster:  A=1  B=2  C=4  D=8  E=16  F=32  G=64
FP_AUTO: Enter  Automatic cluster size     Esc  Back
FP_ZERO: First sector is zero. The rest of the volume has not been inspected.
FP_OTHER: First sector contains data. No matching FAT header was identified.
FP_BPB16: Existing FAT16 header detected. The volume may contain files.
FP_BPB32: Existing FAT32 header detected. The volume may contain files.
FP_TARGET_BAD: This primary entry is not a supported FAT target.
FP_RANGE: Partition extent exceeds the disk or the supported LBA range.
FP_CHS: Partition bounds do not match the reachable BIOS CHS geometry.
FP_EDD: This LBA partition type requires BIOS EDD.
FP_COUNT_BAD: Volume and cluster size do not produce the required FAT family.
FP_DEVICE: BIOS disk 0x80 is unavailable or reports unsupported parameters.
FP_TABLE: The MBR or EBR partition layout was rejected.
FP_IO: A sector needed for the preview could not be read.
FP_CHANGED: The two disk observations differ. Select the partition again.
FR_MODE: Target review with a separate backup disk is enabled.
FR_OFFER: R  Compare the last displayed target with the backup disk
FR_READING: Checking partition boundaries and metadata sectors on both disks.
FR_PROFILE: Boot floppy enrollment is invalid or changed. Target review blocked.
FR_SOURCE_BAD: Target disk missing or different from the enrolled primary master.
FR_COPY_BAD: Backup disk missing or different from the enrolled secondary master.
FR_LBA28: The review range exceeds the LBA28 limit of the IDE reader.
FR_IO: Read error while comparing the two disks.
FR_DIFFERENT: The backup and target contain different bytes in this sector.
FR_LOSS: Formatting could make files on this target unreadable.
FR_CONFIRM: Repeat the slot number for this dry run. Esc cancels.
FR_WRONG: Slot number does not match. Target review cancelled.
FR_DONE: Target confirmed and compared again. No sectors were written.
FW_TICKET: Disk and partition approval is missing or has changed.
FW_LAYOUT: The partition does not match its approved geometry.
FW_FLUSH: The target does not support the required cache flush.
FW_FOREIGN: Unexpected sector contents or write order. Operation blocked.
FW_BACKUP: The backup differs from the approved original data.
FW_FORMAT: F  Create an empty FAT16 filesystem    Esc  End
FW_RESTORE: R  Restore original sectors    Esc  End
FW_CONFIRM: Confirm writes with the partition number. Esc cancels.
FW_WRITING: Writing FAT16 metadata. The boot sector is published last.
FW_RESTORING: Restoring original sectors from the backup.
FW_IO: Write or readback failed. Restart to inspect the disk state.
FW_LIMIT: Too many sector changes for this diskette. Operation blocked.
FW32_FORMAT: F  Create an empty FAT32 filesystem    Esc  End
FW32_WRITING: Writing FAT32 metadata. Both boot sectors are published last.
FW32_EXISTING: The original FAT32 backup boot sector is occupied. Formatting blocked.
IP_SCOPE: Read-only preview. Select an operating system and a primary slot.
IP_OS: 1  MS-DOS 6.22    2  Windows 95 OSR2    3  Windows 98 SE    Esc  Exit
IP_GEOMETRY: The BIOS geometry does not cover the reference layout at 255/63.
IP_DISK: Disk ID or capacity differs from the installation test disk.
IP_LAYOUT: Partition table or volume role differs from the reference layout.
IP_SYSTEM_SLOT: Setup requires a primary system partition.
IP_DOS_FAT: MS-DOS 6.22 requires type 0x06 FAT16 below 2 GiB on this layout.
IP_OCCUPIED: The boot area contains data. This target is protected.
IP_BOOT_CLEAR: Checked boot sectors are empty. Remaining volume contents are unexamined.
IP_VIEW: Setup view: only the target is active and visible. Shared volumes hidden.
IP_COLUMNS: Slot   Table LBA       Offset    Current -> Planned
IP_REPEAT: R  Read the plan from disk again    Esc  Back to selection
IP_CHANGED: The disk or partition tables have changed since the preview.
IV_BACKUP: A backup partition table differs from the approved original.
IV_FOREIGN: The tables contain an unexpected change or write order.
IV_PARTIAL: The switch was interrupted. The changed tables can be restored.
IV_ORIGINAL: The original partition view is confirmed.
IV_RESTORE: R  Restore the original partition view    Esc  Exit
IV_APPLY: A  Apply the displayed partition view    Esc  Exit
IV_IO: Write, disk cache flush or readback failed.
